The "finished" row of a background task in the transcript now opens that task's details, so you can read what a `/code-review` (or any background agent) actually reported.

- Background agents such as `/code-review` hand their result only to Claude, and the transcript showed just `Agent "…" finished`. That row now ends in `›`: click it to open `/desk-tasks` on that task, with the agent's final answer (or a shell's or monitor's output)
- Rows for tasks desk-look has no record of, such as old notifications in a resumed session, stay plain text

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
